usage: agentware config [-h] [--format {text,json}] [--knowledge-dir-only]
                        [--set-knowledge-dir PATH] [--set-org-root PATH]
                        [--set-team TEAM] [--set-org-project NAME]
                        [--set-org-package NAME] [--unset-knowledge-dir]
                        [--kb-autocommit-only] [--set-autocommit on|off]
                        [--kb-push-only] [--set-push on|off]
                        [--retrieval-mode-only]
                        [--set-mode deterministic|semantic]
                        [--set-retrieval bm25|semantic]
                        [--set-embedder DOTTED_NAME|PATH] [--embedder-only]
                        [--set-embed-model MODEL_ID] [--embed-model-only]
                        [--kb-mode-only] [--set-kb-mode power|team]
                        [--cli-only] [--set-cli claude|codex]
                        [--set-pre-cli claude|codex] [--pre-cli-only]
                        [--set-pre-model MODEL_ID] [--pre-model-only]
                        [--set-pre-local lmstudio|ollama] [--pre-local-only]
                        [--set-main-cli claude|codex] [--main-cli-only]
                        [--set-main-model MODEL_ID] [--main-model-only]
                        [--set-main-local lmstudio|ollama] [--main-local-only]
                        [--set-post-cli claude|codex] [--post-cli-only]
                        [--set-post-model MODEL_ID] [--post-model-only]
                        [--set-post-local lmstudio|ollama] [--post-local-only]
                        [--user-handle-only] [--set-user-handle HANDLE]
                        [--record-onboarding] [--skill-propose-threshold-only]
                        [--set-skill-propose-threshold N] [--dream-only]
                        [--set-dream on|off] [--dream-schedule-only]
                        [--set-dream-schedule HH:MM|CRON]
                        [--dream-max-runtime-only]
                        [--set-dream-max-runtime N|Ns|Nm|Nh|off]
                        [--set-updater on|off] [--updater-only]
                        [--set-checkup on|off] [--checkup-only]
                        [--install-git-guards] [--uninstall-git-guards]
                        [--repo PATH] [--skill-promote-only]
                        [--set-skill-promote off|propose]
                        [--set-skill-promote-cap N]
                        [--set-skill-promote-edge-min 0..1]
                        [--set-skill-promote-density-min 0..1]
                        [--set-skill-promote-separation-min 0..1]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --knowledge-dir-only  print only the bare path (for shell consumers)
  --set-knowledge-dir PATH
                        persist the external knowledge-dir pointer to
                        ~/.agentware/config.env (normalized to an absolute
                        path; the sanctioned way to repoint an already-
                        onboarded operator without cmd_init's --force guard;
                        env still overrides per-run)
  --set-org-root PATH   persist AGENTWARE_ORG_ROOT (the org repo root holding
                        teams/ + shared/) — engages org mode + org lint
  --set-team TEAM       persist AGENTWARE_TEAM (resolves to <org-
                        root>/teams/<team>)
  --set-org-project NAME
                        persist AGENTWARE_ORG_PROJECT — the project the org
                        root MUST be (matched against its standard project
                        marker files); the resolver refuses a mis-pointed org
                        root (source-of-truth anchor)
  --set-org-package NAME
                        deprecated spelling of --set-org-project (persists
                        AGENTWARE_ORG_PROJECT)
  --unset-knowledge-dir
                        remove the direct AGENTWARE_KNOWLEDGE_DIR pointer so
                        ORG_ROOT+TEAM takes precedence (org-mode switch)
  --kb-autocommit-only  print only the resolved KB-autocommit setting (1/0)
  --set-autocommit on|off
                        persist the KB-autocommit setting to
                        ~/.agentware/config.env (env still overrides per-run)
  --kb-push-only        print only the resolved KB-push setting (1/0)
  --set-push on|off     persist the KB-push setting to ~/.agentware/config.env
                        (env still overrides per-run)
  --retrieval-mode-only
                        print only the resolved EFFECTIVE retrieval mode
                        (deterministic|semantic) for shell consumers
  --set-mode deterministic|semantic
                        persist the retrieval mode to ~/.agentware/config.env
                        (Mode A deterministic / Mode B semantic; env still
                        overrides per-run)
  --set-retrieval bm25|semantic
                        SETTINGS_AW alias for --set-mode (bm25=Mode A
                        deterministic / semantic=Mode B); persisted to
                        ~/.agentware/config.env
  --set-embedder DOTTED_NAME|PATH
                        persist the LOCAL embedder backend spec (dotted module
                        name e.g. agentware_embedder_fastembed, or a path to a
                        .py backend) to ~/.agentware/config.env
  --embedder-only       print only the resolved embedder backend spec (empty
                        if unset) for shell consumers
  --set-embed-model MODEL_ID
                        persist the embedding model id (e.g. BAAI/bge-small-
                        en-v1.5) to ~/.agentware/config.env
  --embed-model-only    print only the resolved embedding model id for shell
                        consumers
  --kb-mode-only        print only the resolved workspace KB mode (power|team)
                        for shell consumers (onboarding)
  --set-kb-mode power|team
                        persist the workspace KB mode to
                        ~/.agentware/config.env (power=solo local KB /
                        team=shared git KB; distinct from the retrieval --set-
                        mode; env overrides per-run)
  --cli-only            print only the resolved runtime CLI (claude|codex) for
                        shell consumers (the loop's run_agent adapter +
                        onboarding alias generation)
  --set-cli claude|codex
                        persist the runtime CLI to ~/.agentware/config.env
                        (claude=Claude Code / codex=OpenAI Codex; env still
                        overrides per-run; default claude)
  --set-pre-cli claude|codex
                        persist the pre-phase cli to ~/.agentware/config.env
                        (per-phase override of the global value; env still
                        overrides per-run)
  --pre-cli-only        print only the resolved pre-phase cli for shell
                        consumers (the loop's per-phase run_agent adapter)
  --set-pre-model MODEL_ID
                        persist the pre-phase model to ~/.agentware/config.env
                        (per-phase override of the global value; env still
                        overrides per-run)
  --pre-model-only      print only the resolved pre-phase model for shell
                        consumers (the loop's per-phase run_agent adapter)
  --set-pre-local lmstudio|ollama
                        persist the pre-phase local to ~/.agentware/config.env
                        (per-phase override of the global value; env still
                        overrides per-run)
  --pre-local-only      print only the resolved pre-phase local for shell
                        consumers (the loop's per-phase run_agent adapter)
  --set-main-cli claude|codex
                        persist the main-phase cli to ~/.agentware/config.env
                        (per-phase override of the global value; env still
                        overrides per-run)
  --main-cli-only       print only the resolved main-phase cli for shell
                        consumers (the loop's per-phase run_agent adapter)
  --set-main-model MODEL_ID
                        persist the main-phase model to
                        ~/.agentware/config.env (per-phase override of the
                        global value; env still overrides per-run)
  --main-model-only     print only the resolved main-phase model for shell
                        consumers (the loop's per-phase run_agent adapter)
  --set-main-local lmstudio|ollama
                        persist the main-phase local to
                        ~/.agentware/config.env (per-phase override of the
                        global value; env still overrides per-run)
  --main-local-only     print only the resolved main-phase local for shell
                        consumers (the loop's per-phase run_agent adapter)
  --set-post-cli claude|codex
                        persist the post-phase cli to ~/.agentware/config.env
                        (per-phase override of the global value; env still
                        overrides per-run)
  --post-cli-only       print only the resolved post-phase cli for shell
                        consumers (the loop's per-phase run_agent adapter)
  --set-post-model MODEL_ID
                        persist the post-phase model to
                        ~/.agentware/config.env (per-phase override of the
                        global value; env still overrides per-run)
  --post-model-only     print only the resolved post-phase model for shell
                        consumers (the loop's per-phase run_agent adapter)
  --set-post-local lmstudio|ollama
                        persist the post-phase local to
                        ~/.agentware/config.env (per-phase override of the
                        global value; env still overrides per-run)
  --post-local-only     print only the resolved post-phase local for shell
                        consumers (the loop's per-phase run_agent adapter)
  --user-handle-only    print only the resolved per-user provenance handle
                        (empty if unset)
  --set-user-handle HANDLE
                        persist the per-user provenance handle to
                        ~/.agentware/config.env (stamped as `author` on
                        entries this user creates in a shared team KB)
  --record-onboarding   append one onboarding event {mode,user_handle} to
                        <kdir>/logs/metrics.jsonl (gitignored observability)
  --skill-propose-threshold-only
                        print only the resolved skill-proposal ripeness
                        threshold (positive int, default 5) for shell
                        consumers
  --set-skill-propose-threshold N
                        persist the skill-proposal ripeness threshold (a
                        positive integer, default 5) to
                        ~/.agentware/config.env; a proposal is 'ripe' for
                        human-gated promotion once its unique-ref count
                        reaches N (env still overrides per-run)
  --dream-only          print only the resolved dream setting (on|off) for
                        shell consumers (the scheduler installer + idle-gate)
  --set-dream on|off    persist the dream-mode opt-in to
                        ~/.agentware/config.env (default OFF; env still
                        overrides per-run)
  --dream-schedule-only
                        print only the resolved dream schedule token (empty if
                        unset) for shell consumers
  --set-dream-schedule HH:MM|CRON
                        persist the nightly dream schedule (a 24h HH:MM token
                        or a 5-field cron expression) to
                        ~/.agentware/config.env
  --dream-max-runtime-only
                        print only the resolved dream max-runtime cap in
                        seconds (0 = disabled) for shell consumers
  --set-dream-max-runtime N|Ns|Nm|Nh|off
                        persist the best-effort dream wall-clock cap (seconds,
                        or N[s|m|h]; off/0 disables) to
                        ~/.agentware/config.env; fully offline, no network
  --set-updater on|off  persist the automatic signed-channel updater opt-in to
                        ~/.agentware/config.env (default OFF; env
                        AGENTWARE_UPDATE overrides per-run)
  --updater-only        print only the resolved updater setting (on/off)
  --set-checkup on|off  persist the periodic self-exam (checkup) opt-in to
                        ~/.agentware/config.env (default OFF; env
                        AGENTWARE_CHECKUP overrides per-run)
  --checkup-only        print only the resolved checkup setting (on/off)
  --install-git-guards  install the commit-msg co-author strip guard into a
                        git repo (default: the knowledge-dir KB repo). Opt-in,
                        non-clobber; strips Claude/AI co-author trailers from
                        operator commits without ever blocking a commit
  --uninstall-git-guards
                        remove the agentware commit-msg guard (restoring a
                        backed-up foreign hook if present)
  --repo PATH           target repo for --install/--uninstall-git-guards
                        (default: the configured knowledge dir)
  --skill-promote-only  print only the resolved skill-promotion mode
                        (off|propose) for shell consumers
  --set-skill-promote off|propose
                        persist the skill-promotion mode (detect + PROPOSE
                        only; never authors or installs) to
                        ~/.agentware/config.env (default propose; env still
                        overrides per-run)
  --set-skill-promote-cap N
                        persist the per-run skill-candidate emission cap (non-
                        negative int; 0 = detect/report only)
  --set-skill-promote-edge-min 0..1
                        persist the min edge-weight detection threshold (float
                        in [0.0, 1.0])
  --set-skill-promote-density-min 0..1
                        persist the min subgraph-density detection threshold
                        (float in [0.0, 1.0])
  --set-skill-promote-separation-min 0..1
                        persist the min separation-margin detection threshold
                        (float in [0.0, 1.0])
